Home Lko. ... on 6 June, 2025
Author: Rajesh Singh Chauhan

Bench: Rajesh Singh Chauhan
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Petitioner :- Shivendra S Singh Rathore,Ishan Baghel,Nishchal Verma,Sachin U
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Shailendra Misra
Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Additional Government Advocate for the
State-respondent and learned counsel for the opposite party No.4.

2.  By means of this petition, the petitioner has prayed for quashing the FIR as Case Crime No. 69 of 2020, under sections 406, 419, 420, 467, 471, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Wazirganj, District Lucknow.

sentences.text:
This Court vide order dated 07.05.2025 directed the parties to appear before the senior registrar for verification of the compromise entered into between the parties on 16.05.2025.
4.

In compliance of the aforesaid order, the parties appeared before the senior registrar on 16.05.2025 to verify the aforesaid compromise and after verification of contents of the compromise and the parties thereof, the senior registrar has submitted his report dated 16.05.2025.
5. Learned counsel for the opposite party No.4 has also submitted that the dispute between the parties has been amicably settled through compromise.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the issue in question, particularly, the fact that the present petitioner and the private opposite party have settled their dispute through compromise,
which has been verified by the senior registrar, therefore, compelling the prosecution to prosecute the present petitioner would to be a futile exercise and in view of the dictum of Hon'ble Supreme Court rendered in re: B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and Another; 2003 (4) SCC 675,
Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab (2012) 10 SCC 303; State of Rajasthan vs. Shambhu Kewat, (2014) 4 SCC 149; State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Deepak (2014) 10 SCC 285; State of Madhya Pradesh vs.
Manish (2015) 8 SCC 307; J.Ramesh Kamath vs. Mohana Kurup (2016) 12 SCC 179; State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Rajveer Singh (2016) 12 SCC 471; Parbatbhai Aahir vs. State of Gujarat (2017) 9 SCC 641, the impugned FIR as Case Crime No. 69 of 2020, under sections 406, 419, 420, 467, 471,
504, 506 IPC, Police Station Wazirganj, District Lucknow is hereby quashed.
